Claim 1 (currently amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and each having a pair of flanges extending from the web, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

Claim 5 (currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas of the flanges.

Claim 15 (currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels include a continuously manufactured cross-section.

Claim 25 (currently amended): A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges, the structure including radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap being joined to the first set of flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of adhesive joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
